defective_pattern: Repeating variable names verbatim across every row in multi-subscale tables, or grouping all overall scales in one block and orphaning subscales in another block.
why_defective: Clutters tables with redundant text, degrades data-ink ratio, and severs the visual linkage between parent constructs and their subscales.
observed_symptoms: Repeating 'خودآسیبی' on every subscale row in Table 9-4
Listing 5 overall scales at top of Table 10-4 then dumping subscales with empty parent cells below
corrective_remedy: Structure tables hierarchically: write one row for the parent variable, list its subscales in column 2 on subsequent rows, then proceed to the next parent variable.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Flag two-column tables where Col 0 repeats identical parent variable names on consecutive rows, or where subscale rows appear without immediate preceding parent variable rows.
